column1: Event and Decision Worksheet|Turn a vague worry into a concrete event you can understand and act on.|What happened, where and when?;What specific outcome do I want?;What facts are confirmed and what remains an assumption?;What two explanations are plausible?;Which conditions can I change and who else has authority?;What is my first safe action and when will I review it?

SSCM Five-Dimension Worksheet|Examine capability, reachable support, roles, contribution and autonomy without scoring yourself.|Situation, objective and external constraints;C: What can I demonstrate, and what do I still need to learn?;N: What legitimate contacts and public services are reachable?;R: What are my responsibilities and decision rights?;V: What contribution has actually been delivered and confirmed?;A: Can I choose, renegotiate, delay or exit responsibly?

Support and Official-Access Map|Find people and services that can actually respond, rather than counting contacts.|What type of problem am I facing?;What is the first official information or service channel?;Who can clarify and who has decision authority?;When can I reasonably expect a response?;What is the next safe channel if there is no response?;What private information should I avoid sharing?

Rule-Checking Worksheet|Verify requirements for courses, awards, housing, internships and other formal matters.|What precise rule applies to my situation?;Which institution published it and when?;Who is covered by this version?;What are the eligibility rules, dates and appeal routes?;What conflicts with informal advice or online rumors?;Who can provide an authorized clarification?

Help Request and Professional Communication|Prepare an answerable question that respects the other person's role and time.|Who has the authority or expertise to help?;What is the relevant background?;What have I already tried?;What one or two specific questions remain?;Which official channel and documents should I use?;How will I act on the response?

Team Responsibilities and Delivery Agreement|Make shared tasks reviewable, fair and possible to adjust.|What is the shared objective and acceptance standard?;Who owns each deliverable and by when?;Who may make each kind of decision?;What resources and support are available?;How will delays or changed requirements be handled?;How will contributions and handover be documented?

Boundaries and Saying No|Clarify requests involving time, money, consent and privacy.|What exactly is the request?;Is it a genuine obligation or a voluntary favor?;What is acceptable to me and what is not?;How can I respond clearly and respectfully?;Is there a legitimate alternative I can suggest?;What support do I need if there is pressure or retaliation?

Conflict Clarification and Repair|Separate observable events, effects and remedies before deciding the relationship's future.|What happened and what evidence exists?;How has it affected each person?;What rules or promises matter?;What change or remedy would address the issue?;Is the other party willing and able to change?;Do I need mediation, distance or formal protection?

Contribution and Evidence Record|Describe actual work fairly, especially for research, projects and employment.|What was the task and my actual responsibility?;What method or tools did I use?;What result can be independently verified?;What was done by others or as a team?;What limits, defects or unresolved issues remain?;Which materials can legally and ethically be shared?

Compare Realistic Options|Evaluate study, career and organization choices without treating one route as mandatory.|What objective matters to me and why?;What are option A's entry requirements, costs and reversibility?;What are option B's entry requirements, costs and reversibility?;Is there a third or delayed option?;Which important facts still need verification?;When would I change my decision?

Rights Incident and Support Record|Prepare factual, private documentation for a review, complaint or safety concern.|What happened and is anyone in immediate danger?;Which official rule or right may apply?;What evidence can I preserve safely and lawfully?;Which offices have I contacted and when?;Who has authority to review or protect?;What privacy and retaliation risks must be managed?

Monthly Growth and Relationship Review|Notice meaningful changes without assigning a social maturity score.|Which three concrete events mattered this month?;What capability now has stronger evidence?;Which connections supported or overloaded me?;Were my responsibilities matched with authority?;Which choices were informed and revisable?;What one manageable next step will I try?
